No assigned method paragraph authorizes this method; format validation and two-reference comparison cannot authorize promotion.
disposition: Moved from docs/downloads to evidence/quarantine. The original raster and sidecars are retained unchanged for audit history; no new raster was generated and no experiment or slot was used by this review.
